title: Longest Palindromic Substring
statement: Return the longest contiguous substring of s that is a palindrome. Several answers can tie, and any of the longest is accepted.
hints: Every palindrome has a centre. There are 2n-1 of them: one at each character, and one between each adjacent pair.
From each centre, expand outward while the characters match, and remember the longest span you achieve.
Handle odd and even length palindromes as two separate expansions from each index.
